prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1416; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a busy road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact pushed me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt an immediate tightening across my lower back. I got out of the car and spoke with the other driver, then later with the adjuster and the officer at the scene, and I have described the events the same way every time: I was stationary, the other vehicle did not slow down, and the collision happened without warning. I am the named driver on the policy covering the car I was operating. Since the collision I have been seeing a doctor for a back strain, which has limited my ability to lift and sit for long periods. I am providing this statement so the claim can be reviewed, and I am willing to supply any medical records or photographs that would help.
